## About
Park's Transmission & Services is a transmission shop on Long Beach Blvd. Transmission diagnostics, repair and rebuilding are what we specialize in, whether your car is automatic or manual.
We also take care of the rest of your car, from oil changes and brakes to cooling systems, exhaust and factory recommended maintenance. Steve owns the shop and Eddie runs it as shop manager.
If a repair comes up when you weren't planning for it, we offer financing through Synchrony Car Care. We're rated 4.5 on Google from 119 reviews.

## Services
- Transmission repair and rebuilding: Diagnosis, repair and rebuilding for automatic and manual transmissions.
- Clutch service and repair: Clutch repair for manual transmission cars.
- CVT transmission service: Service for continuously variable transmissions.
- Power Purge® and maintenance: Transmission maintenance, including Power Purge® service.
- Check engine light service: We'll track down why that light came on.
- Brakes and A/C: Brake work and air conditioning service.
- Oil, lube and filter change: Routine oil changes to keep your engine running right.
- Factory recommended maintenance: Scheduled maintenance, tune-ups and multi-point inspections.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

Q: Do you work on manual transmissions?
A: Yes. We diagnose, repair and rebuild both automatic and manual transmissions.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. We offer financing programs through Synchrony Car Care so you can get the repair taken care of now.
